professionalSummary: Experienced Implementation Consultant with three years of configuring payroll and absence products for 23 mid‑size employers under the company’s configuration standard.
Proven ability to run policy workshops, resolve internal disagreements, and capture decisions with customer sign‑off.
Skilled in loading and reconciling employee data in collaboration with the data migration team.
Delivered training to HR administrators while maintaining clear go‑live approval boundaries.
Documented implementation limitations and hand‑over conditions for support transition.
experienceHighlights: Configured payroll and absence products for 23 employers (src_7e49dd25f708).
Ran policy workshops using the workshop method, resolving disagreements and recording decisions with sign‑off (src_71c929824723).
Loaded and reconciled employee data with the data migration team, producing signed reconciliation reports (src_6a74076ca1e6).
Trained HR administrators under a structured training plan; go‑live approval remained with the implementation manager (src_412517805c96).
Authored limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each implementation (src_d49f1fc763bc).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Reconciliation report signed by HR lead (src_097a7224d9aa).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct experience with all required activities for the Implementation Consultant role, while the interview note offers contextual insight into workshop facilitation.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit.

evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty‑three mid‑sized employers under the configuration standard.

Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign‑off on each workshop record.
Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
evidence.notes: Data loading and reconciliation with sign‑off.

evidence.text: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go‑live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go‑live checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand‑over conditions for each implementation in the hand‑over pack to the support team.

supportedClaims.claim: Configured payroll and absence products for 23 mid‑size employers.
supportedClaims.witness: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty‑three mid‑sized employers under the configuration standard.

supportedClaims.claim: Ran policy workshops resolving internal disagreements and capturing decisions with sign‑off.
supportedClaims.witness: Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign‑off on each workshop record.

supportedClaims.claim: Loaded and reconciled employee data with the data migration team, producing signed reconciliation reports.
supportedClaims.witness: Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.

supportedClaims.claim: Trained HR administrators while maintaining clear go‑live approval boundaries.
supportedClaims.witness: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go‑live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go‑live checklist together with which checks were mine.

supportedClaims.claim: Documented implementation limitations and hand‑over conditions for support transition.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand‑over conditions for each implementation in the hand‑over pack to the support team.

interviewSignalRisks.text: In the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify the described facilitation with workshop records.
